resources.string: Choose a microG account and allow BitChord to manage your YouTube music library. microG connects to Google using its own network settings.
Checking the account with YouTube Music…
Approve access in microG. If BitChord is already back on screen, you can check the permission now.
microG did not respond within 30 seconds. Check that microG can reach Google, then try again. If you use BitChord’s WireGuard proxy, microG needs its own connection.
YouTube access still needs approval in microG. Choose the account again to retry.
Install or enable microG Services or ReVanced GmsCore, then choose an account again.
microG could not authorize this account. Check its network connection and the Android OAuth registration for this APK, then try again.
YouTube Music could not verify this account. Check your connection and try again.
